posts.subject: Application for Admin | MiniGame Server
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello, i'd like to be an admin on your servers!


1) What is your name? Real & Ingame - my real name is tomer my name in game is superman g2a.com


2) How old are you? - im 16 years old my b.day was today 🙂


3) Why do you want to join our administrative team? - i want to join to the adminstravite team because THIS SERVER IS AWESOME and because i want to translation for you what the Israeli community talks in hebrew because sometimes they say how much HP a player got or curse each other in hewbrew and the admins dont understand what they say


4) How long have you been playing on our servers? - i played on your server alomost a year and i will continue to play


5) What are your favourite hobbies or pastimes? - I like to watch gameplays, play with freinds , ride a bicycle and to play at pc


6) Do you think of yourself as mature? - Yes. I almost only have friends older than me, i love to have a good talk about something importan
or [funny]


7) Have you gained experience as an administrator before? -yes i had a lot of expirience. i was an admin in my friend isreali bhop server (it doesn't exist anymore)


[8)] When do you play? (timetable of your average week) - I play like 80 hours in 2 week. on your servers i play like 36 hours


9) User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take? - First i will warn user 1. If user 1 will continue to curse user 2 i will kick him. If he will keep curse user 1 i would ban him for 30 min. if after 30 min he still keep to curse user 1 i will ban him for 1 day (24 hours)


10) Strengths:


i know to speck hebrew so when someone curses in Hebrew I knew what he said


i am always happy to help those who need help


11) Weaknesses:
My father has cancer so when someone curses him I always hurt


12) Conclusion / Closing remark - I just really would like to be an admin on your Mini Games server. I hope you will accept me!About me: Im just really an nice teenager, from isreal who likes to play games and talk in English.


13) Because Nachtfrische wont believe me so my stamm point are 15800 and my rank on the server is 59 and you can check my profile again i have 159 hours in the past 2 week. my steam profile:
im applying to the Mini Games server thank you for reading Tomer "superman g2a.com" kachlon and have a nice day!

At least write a different application than before, you copy & pasted your previous one and added the last three paragraphs. You didn't even bother fixing typos like "expirience".


Another no from me.


PS:

Zitat von Superman g2a.com

3) Why do you want to join our administrative team? - (...) because i want to translation for you what the Israeli community talks in hebrew because sometimes they say how much HP a player got or curse each other in hewbrew and the admins dont understand what they say

You shouldn't be talking or translating Hebrew at all, because English and German are the only allowed languages in the (voice) chat.

Superman,


I know you, you are a nice guy who NEVER break the rules
so i can only say a big YES from me. 🙂


Btw. Happy B-Day and Greets from Germany 🙂

You seem like a nice guy, but @Nachtfrische is right.
I like the application beneath the mistakes and the fact that you copied your Application.


I also have to tell you an Admin has to do more than just translate, you have to watch that other users follow the rules.
Talking about translation, only German and English is allowed on the Servers so at that point you have to tell the people they should communicate in the given languages, if you help them translate you just motivate them to keep talking in their own language.


Im going to give you a no , but if you dont copy the application next time i might think about a yes! 🙂


And Happy Bday btw.

Zitat von Nachtfrische

+1 Sry, but it is a no for me. You are a nice guy but i dont think you have the maturity.

The Dream leadership apologizes for the somewhat longer processing time.
